note: Screen only. screen_conclusions.appended_by: post-processing; every number below is derived from the fields above

reasons: no small hot set exists: top-16 of 512 experts cover only 25.3% of pairs; top-128 (a quarter of the pool) covers 73.6%
routing is diffuse: 335/512 experts (~65%) are selected per (layer,chunk); ~1.05 GB of expert weights are streamed per capture
hot-set capacity is infeasible: top-8-per-layer across 48 layers is already 1.2 GB vs MB-class caches
hot sets are case-specific: cross-case top-32 Jaccard 0.316 - no universal hot set even if capacity existed
consecutive-chunk set stability (Jaccard 0.797) is stability of a LARGE diffuse set, not a reuse lever

a_residual_within_expert_tile_reuse.ceiling: perfect within-expert weight-tile reuse cuts expert weight-read traffic up to 2.32x (897210 16-row fragments vs 386017 distinct selections)
a_residual_within_expert_tile_reuse.kernel_structure: confirmed in gguf_q4_k_selected_prefill.hip: each (col_tile,row_tile) block re-reads the expert weight rows; adjacent fragments may already hit L2, so 2.32x is an upper bound pending rocprof memory counters
a_residual_within_expert_tile_reuse.promotion_condition: only if kernel-level profiling shows fragment weight re-reads are material AND the 3-plane iu8 compute tax (the dominant R13 factor) is not; arithmetic-preserving (scheduling only) if attempted

reasons: same-set prediction covers only 37.7% of the next step's selections (exact repeat rate 0.16%)

decode expert weight traffic is ~1.5 GB/step = ~29 GB/s at the 52.3 ms/token TG median - far below the platform memory peak, so expert weight fetch is not the decode bottleneck; overlap/prefetch cannot move TG materially

cross-chunk prefill routing pipelining is blocked by the sequential dependency: chunk t+1's router input depends on chunk t's full forward pass (speculating hidden states would change arithmetic and violate the no-exactness-relaxation constraint)

screen_conclusions.constraint_compliance: screen only; no runtime default changes, no arithmetic changes; all measurements observational (between-layer-call hooks)
